name: Mitte
description: Central and busy, with museums, offices and great transport links.

name: Kreuzberg
description: Lively and creative, full of cafés, bars, street food and canal-side walks.

name: Friedrichshain
description: Young and energetic, known for nightlife, street art and the East Side Gallery.

name: Prenzlauer Berg
description: Leafy and family-friendly, with old buildings, playgrounds and weekend markets.

name: Neukölln
description: Diverse and trendy, with international food, Tempelhofer Feld and a young crowd.

name: Charlottenburg
description: Elegant and calm, with wide boulevards, the palace gardens and classic shopping.

name: Schöneberg
description: Relaxed and residential, with good restaurants, markets and a strong community feel.

name: Wedding
description: Affordable and changing fast, with parks, lakes and an authentic neighbourhood vibe.

name: Moabit
description: Quiet and central, surrounded by water, with a local market hall.

name: Pankow
description: Green and peaceful, with villas, parks and a small-town feeling.

name: Steglitz
description: Calm and suburban, with a botanical garden and good shopping streets.

name: Treptow
description: Green and spacious, next to Treptower Park and the river Spree.
